HelpText:
HOW TO PLAY

Choose Easy (2×2, 45s), Normal (2×3, 60s) or Hard (4×4, 120s). Select Start Game, then Start on the board.

Select two cards with the mouse or Tab then Space. Identical creatures stay visible. A mismatch closes after 750ms; a third card cannot be selected during the delay.

Match: +100 points. Mismatch: −10, minimum zero. Victory bonus: 5 × remaining seconds. A move is two valid selections; clicks count individual valid selections.

Pause freezes time and the mismatch delay and conceals the cards. Resume continues. Restart creates a new shuffled deck in Ready state. Return to Menu ends the current round.

Match all pairs before zero to win. Enter a name of 1–24 characters, Save Result, then View Leaderboard. Results sort by score descending, moves and completion seconds ascending; difficulty and outcome are shown.

In Settings, choose Tiếng Việt or English. The UI updates immediately without changing score, time or card order. The clock continues while Settings is open; pause first if needed. The language is restored on the next launch.

Sound toggles background and feedback audio together. Missing resources produce warnings and safe fallback designs; gameplay continues.
